## Summary

Describe the change and any new data field, network request, dependency, file output, or logging behavior.

## Privacy checklist

- [ ] Tests use only handwritten synthetic data.
- [ ] No credential, account data, institution name, private path, live payload, screenshot, trace, database, export, or log is included.
- [ ] Plaid calls and secrets remain server-only.
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes.
- [ ] `gitleaks git . --redact` passes.
